newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SOCCER-MANDELA GIVES GULLIT SPECIAL AWARD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MANDELA GIVES GULLIT SPECIAL AWARD.

text.p: Former Dutch international Ruud Gullit was given South Africa's highest decoration for foreigners by South African president Nelson Mandela on Wednesday.

Mandela presented Gullit, manager of English premier league club Chelsea, with the Order of Good Hope (commander class) at halftime in the friendly between South Africa and the Netherlands in Johannesburg.
Gullit was honoured for dedicating his 1987 European Footballer of the Year award to the then imprisoned South African leader.
"You have been a longstanding supporter of South Africa's struggle for democracy and a champion on and off the field," Mandela told Gullit at the ceremony.
Gullitt said his dedication 10 years ago had not been a political statement.
"I just thought it was something human to do. Every person in the world needs freedom."
